name: Laya
description: Open-weight System 1 judgments (choice, score, noul) from Laya, running locally on this machine. A free, multilingual alternative to TypeSafe Jev for routing and guard signals.

provider.label: Laya (local)
provider.description: Structured choice, score, and noul judgments from Laya checkpoints run by a local Python sidecar.

onboarding.subtitle: Run calibrated routing and guard judgments on your own hardware, no API key.

steps.title: Install Laya
steps.desc: Creates an isolated Python environment under ~/.local/share/recursive/laya. Pulls in PyTorch and Transformers; a GPU is optional. Copy the printed Python path into the next step.
steps.command: python3 -m venv "$HOME/.local/share/recursive/laya" && "$HOME/.local/share/recursive/laya/bin/python" -m pip install --upgrade laya && echo "Python command: $HOME/.local/share/recursive/laya/bin/python"

steps.title: Choose the Python environment
steps.desc: Use the Python 3.10+ command where the laya package is installed.

steps.title: Load a checkpoint and test
steps.desc: Downloads the selected checkpoint from Hugging Face on first run (~1.5 GB), then answers a probe question.

schema.label: Python command
schema.description: Python environment containing the laya package. Ignored when a server URL is set.

schema.label: Checkpoint
schema.description: auto lets Laya's Router pick per request from the detected script and language; english is fastest on English-only workloads.

schema.label: Device
schema.description: Torch device for inference. auto prefers CUDA, then Apple MPS, then CPU.

schema.label: Preload every checkpoint
schema.description: Keep all three checkpoints resident (~4.6 GB RAM) so auto routing never reloads a model between languages.

schema.label: Timeout (ms)
schema.description: Hard timeout for decision model calls. Calls made while a checkpoint is still loading fail open.

schema.label: Server URL
schema.description: Optional. Use a remote `laya_helper.py serve-http` instance (for example http://gpu-box:8765) instead of a local sidecar.

config.description: Laya sidecar runtime options; no credentials.
